# Element-wise math

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.swift from the Quiver 1.6.0 public API. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every API below exists in Quiver 1.0.0 and later unless it is tagged *(since X)*. Each entry is the declaration, then the first line of its documentation.

## Array extensions where Element: Numeric

- `func add(_ other: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Element-wise addition of two vectors. Returns: A new array where each element is the sum of corresponding elements
- `func subtract(_ other: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Element-wise subtraction of two vectors. Returns: A new array where each element is the difference of corresponding elements
- `func multiply(_ other: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Element-wise multiplication of two vectors (Hadamard product). Returns: A new array where each element is the product of corresponding elements
- `func broadcast(adding value: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts a scalar addition operation to each element Returns: A new array with the scalar added to each element
- `func broadcast(multiplyingBy value: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts a scalar multiplication operation to each element Returns: A new array with each element multiplied by the scalar
- `func broadcast(subtracting value: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts a scalar subtraction operation to each element Returns: A new array with the scalar subtracted from each element
- `func broadcast(with value: Element, operation: (Element, Element) -> Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts a custom operation with a scalar value to each element Returns: A new array with the operation applied to each element
- `static func + (lhs: [Element], rhs: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar addition to each element of the vector Returns: A new vector with the scalar added to each element
- `static func + (lhs: Element, rhs: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar addition to each element of the vector (commutative) Returns: A new vector with the scalar added to each element
- `static func - (lhs: [Element], rhs: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar subtraction from each element of the vector Returns: A new vector with the scalar subtracted from each element
- `static func - (lhs: Element, rhs: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar subtraction with reversed operands (scalar - vector) Returns: A new vector with each element subtracted from the scalar
- `static func * (lhs: [Element], rhs: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar multiplication to each element of the vector Returns: A new vector with each element multiplied by the scalar
- `static func * (lhs: Element, rhs: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar multiplication to each element of the vector (commutative) Returns: A new vector with each element multiplied by the scalar

## Array extensions where Element: FloatingPoint

- `func divide(_ other: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Element-wise division of two vectors. Returns: A new array where each element is the quotient of corresponding elements
- `func broadcast(dividingBy value: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts a scalar division operation to each element Returns: A new array with each element divided by the scalar
- `static func / (lhs: [Element], rhs: Element) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar division to each element of the vector Returns: A new vector with each element divided by the scalar
- `static func / (lhs: Element, rhs: [Element]) -> [Element]` — Broadcasts scalar division with reversed operands (scalar / vector) Returns: A new vector with the scalar divided by each element

## Array extensions where Element == [Double]

- `func add(_ other: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Element-wise addition of two matrices. Returns: A new matrix where each element is the sum of corresponding elements
- `func subtract(_ other: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Element-wise subtraction of two matrices. Returns: A new matrix where each element is the difference of corresponding elements
- `func multiply(_ other: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Element-wise multiplication of two matrices (Hadamard product). Returns: A new matrix where each element is the product of corresponding elements
- `func divide(_ other: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Element-wise division of two matrices. Returns: A new matrix where each element is the quotient of corresponding elements
- `static func + (lhs: [[Double]], rhs: Double) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar addition to each element of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with the scalar added to each element
- `static func + (lhs: Double, rhs: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar addition to each element of the matrix (commutative) Returns: A new matrix with the scalar added to each element
- `static func - (lhs: [[Double]], rhs: Double) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar subtraction from each element of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with the scalar subtracted from each element
- `static func - (lhs: Double, rhs: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar subtraction with reversed operands (scalar - matrix) Returns: A new matrix with each element subtracted from the scalar
- `static func * (lhs: [[Double]], rhs: Double) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar multiplication to each element of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with each element multiplied by the scalar
- `static func * (lhs: Double, rhs: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar multiplication to each element of the matrix (commutative) Returns: A new matrix with each element multiplied by the scalar
- `static func / (lhs: [[Double]], rhs: Double) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar division to each element of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with each element divided by the scalar
- `static func / (lhs: Double, rhs: [[Double]]) -> [[Double]]` — Broadcasts scalar division with reversed operands (scalar / matrix) Returns: A new matrix with the scalar divided by each element

## Array extensions where Element.Element: Numeric, Element: Collection

- `func broadcast(addingToEachRow vector: [Element.Element]) -> [[Element.Element]]` — Broadcasts a row vector across each row of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with the vector added to each row
- `func broadcast(addingToEachColumn vector: [Element.Element]) -> [[Element.Element]]` — Broadcasts a column vector across each column of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with the vector added to each column
- `func broadcast(multiplyingEachRowBy vector: [Element.Element]) -> [[Element.Element]]` — Broadcasts a row vector multiplication across each row of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with each row multiplied by the vector
- `func broadcast(multiplyingEachColumnBy vector: [Element.Element]) -> [[Element.Element]]` — Broadcasts a column vector multiplication across each column of the matrix Returns: A new matrix with each column multiplied by the vector
- `func broadcast(withRowVector vector: [Element.Element], operation: (Element.Element, Element.Element) -> Element.Element) -> [[Element.Element]]` — Broadcasts a custom row operation across the matrix Returns: A new matrix with the operation applied to each row
- `func broadcast(withColumnVector vector: [Element.Element], operation: (Element.Element, Element.Element) -> Element.Element) -> [[Element.Element]]` — Broadcasts a custom column operation across the matrix Returns: A new matrix with the operation applied to each column

## Array extensions where Element == Double

- `func power(_ exponent: Double) -> [Double]` — Raises each element to the specified power. Returns: A new array where each element is raised to the given exponent
- `func sin() -> [Double]` — Returns the sine of each element in the array. Returns: A new array of sine values, with inputs interpreted as radians
- `func cos() -> [Double]` — Returns the cosine of each element in the array. Returns: A new array of cosine values, with inputs interpreted as radians
- `func tan() -> [Double]` — Returns the tangent of each element in the array. Returns: A new array of tangent values, with inputs interpreted as radians
- `func floor() -> [Double]` — Returns the floor of each element in the array. Returns: A new array where each element is rounded down to the nearest integer
- `func ceil() -> [Double]` — Returns the ceiling of each element in the array. Returns: A new array where each element is rounded up to the nearest integer
- `func round() -> [Double]` — Returns the rounded value of each element in the array. Returns: A new array where each element is rounded to the nearest integer
- `func rounded(to places: Int) -> [Double]` — Returns each element rounded to a specified number of decimal places. Returns: A new array with each element rounded to the specified precision *(since 1.0.1)*
- `func log() -> [Double]` — Returns the natural logarithm of each element in the array. Returns: A new array of natural log values (base e)
- `func log10() -> [Double]` — Returns the base-10 logarithm of each element in the array. Returns: A new array of base-10 log values
- `func exp() -> [Double]` — Returns e raised to the power of each element in the array. Returns: A new array where each element is the exponential e^x
- `func sqrt() -> [Double]` — Returns the square root of each element in the array. Returns: A new array of square root values
- `func square() -> [Double]` — Returns the square of each element in the array. Returns: A new array where each element is multiplied by itself
- `func softMax() -> [Double]` — Converts raw scores into a probability distribution that sums to 1.0. Returns: A probability distribution with the same length as the input.
- `func sigmoid() -> [Double]` — Applies the sigmoid function to each element: σ(x) = 1 / (1 + e⁻ˣ). Returns: An array of values in (0, 1), one per input element.
